stemMd: A trapezoid has parallel sides 6 and 14 and area 70. What is its height?
explanationMd: Area equals the average base length times height. The average is 10, so height is 70/10=7. The formula uses perpendicular height.

distractorRationale.c: This is the mean of the bases.
distractorRationale.e: This is the sum of the bases.
distractorRationale.a: This divides by the full base sum without the one-half factor.
